imd._note: IMD's latest extended-range outlook, refreshed by the Nykas Daily Refresh when IMD issues a new one (usually Thursdays). categories: above / near / below for an IMD sub-division only when IMD states it; otherwise left out.
imd.title: IMD extended range forecast (weekly press release), 8 October 2026: current weather status and extended range forecast for the next two weeks (8 to 21 October 2026)
imd.summary: Isolated to scattered rain over Rayalaseema, Tamil Nadu and Coastal Andhra Pradesh through 14 October, with a low-pressure area likely over the south-east Bay of Bengal around 13 October that may move towards north Tamil Nadu and the south Andhra coast. For 15–21 October IMD expects conditions to favour the onset of the north-east monsoon and rainfall above normal over south Peninsular India.

weeks.label: Week 1
weeks.text: Isolated to scattered rainfall likely over Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Rayalaseema, Coastal and South Interior Karnataka and Tamil Nadu during 8–14 October; fairly widespread to widespread rain over Kerala on 8–10 and 14 October, with isolated heavy rain over Kerala and Tamil Nadu on 8–10 October. A low-pressure area is likely over the south-east Bay of Bengal around 13 October and may move north-westwards towards north Tamil Nadu and the south Andhra coast. Rainfall for the country as a whole is likely to be below normal; no category is given for South Peninsular India.

regional_text.Rayalaseema: Isolated to scattered rainfall likely during 8–14 October.
regional_text.Tamil Nadu: Isolated to scattered rainfall likely during 8–14 October, with isolated heavy rain on 8–10 October.

weeks.label: Week 2
weeks.text: Conditions likely to become favourable for the onset of the north-east monsoon over South Peninsular India at the beginning of the week. Scattered to fairly widespread rainfall likely over most parts of Peninsular India, with isolated heavy rain over Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, South Interior Karnataka and Kerala on a few days. Rainfall likely to be above normal over south Peninsular India.

regional_text.Rayalaseema: Not named separately; IMD expects scattered to fairly widespread rain over most of Peninsular India and above-normal rainfall over south Peninsular India.
regional_text.Tamil Nadu: Isolated heavy rain likely on a few days; north-east monsoon onset conditions expected at the start of the week; above-normal rainfall expected over south Peninsular India.

season.text: October–December (north-east monsoon) rainfall over South Peninsular India is most likely normal (88–112% of the long-period average). October rainfall is likely below normal for India as a whole, but normal to above normal over southern parts of the peninsula. Strong El Niño conditions are expected to strengthen to the end of the year; the Indian Ocean Dipole is neutral.
